newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moroccan buyers pass 12,000 T wheat tender - trade.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan buyers pass 12,000 T wheat tender - trade.

text.p: Private Moroccan importers have passed up offers in a tender for the import of 12,000 tonnes of optional-origin milling wheat, European grain traders said on Thursday.
Importers tendered on January 21 for a wheat delivery by January 31, a deadline exporters said was too tight.

Moroccan importers are still scheduled to tender on Thursday for 15,000 tonnes of optional-origin milling wheat for delivery between February 25 and March 5 to the ports of Nador and Safi, traders said.
